families.name: Doji
families.def: body <= 10% of the range: open and close almost equal
families.why: buyers and sellers ended even inside the candle: a pause or indecision, not a direction
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Dragonfly doji
families.def: doji with a lower wick >= 60% and almost no upper wick
families.why: sellers pushed down, buyers bought it all back to the open: demand below (a rejection of lower prices)
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Gravestone doji
families.def: doji with an upper wick >= 60% and almost no lower wick
families.why: buyers pushed up, sellers sold it all back to the open: supply above
families.verdict: 2 instrument/timeframe finding(s), more down than matched candles; 0 held out of sample

families.name: Long-legged doji
families.def: doji with both wicks >= 30% and range >= 1 ATR
families.why: a wide two-way fight that ended even: high uncertainty, often around news or a level
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Spinning top
families.def: small body (10-35%) with both wicks >= 25%
families.why: neither side in control; momentum fading
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Green marubozu
families.def: body >= 85% of the range, range >= 0.8 ATR, green
families.why: buyers in control from open to close with no pullback: urgency / aggressive buying
families.verdict: 2 instrument/timeframe finding(s), more up than matched candles; 1 held out of sample

families.name: Red marubozu
families.def: body >= 85%, range >= 0.8 ATR, red
families.why: sellers in control from open to close: urgency / aggressive selling
families.verdict: 2 instrument/timeframe finding(s), more down than matched candles; 0 held out of sample

families.name: Big green body

families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Big red body

families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Hammer
families.def: lower wick >= 60%, body 10-35%, upper wick <= 15%, after a down trend
families.why: sellers pushed lower but buyers absorbed it and closed near the top: a possible bottom (stop run then reclaim)
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Hanging man
families.def: the hammer shape after an UP trend
families.why: the same shape at a top: selling appeared inside the candle; the textbook calls it a warning
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Hammer shape, no trend
families.def: the hammer shape with no clear trend before
families.why: a rejected dip in a range
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Inverted hammer
families.def: upper wick >= 60%, body 10-35%, lower wick <= 15%, after a down trend
families.why: buyers tried to lift price after a fall; the textbook calls it an early bottom attempt
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Shooting star
families.def: the inverted-hammer shape after an UP trend
families.why: buyers pushed up, sellers rejected it and closed near the low: a possible top
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Inverted shape, no trend
families.def: the inverted-hammer shape with no trend
families.why: a rejected rally in a range
families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Big head (big upper wick)

families.why: price went up and was sold back: supply / profit taking / a failed breakout above
families.verdict: 1 instrument/timeframe finding(s), more down than matched candles; 0 held out of sample

families.name: Big tail (big lower wick)

families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Big head AND big tail

families.name: Small head and small tail

families.name: Absorption (effort without result)

families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Climax candle

families.name: Stop run above the day's high

families.name: Stop run below the day's low

families.name: Heavy-volume tail

families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)

families.name: Heavy-volume head
families.def: upper wick >= 40% that carries >= 50% of the candle's activity

families.verdict: no edge: after it, price moves like any matched candle (same time, trend, volatility, colour)
